rows.amal_said: this is scared. What's scary? ... It's a verb-based adjective. ... There you go.
rows.why: خايف means scared (state). For scary he needed the doubled-middle verb بيخوّف. After tries مخاف and بخاف he got بخوّف and Amal said 'There you go'.
A b- (I) form instead of bey- (it) for 'this'. Amal's chat has bey5awwef, but the engine may have dropped the ي; later he says بيخوّف right. Probably engine.
For 'another movie' kamaan goes before the noun. Amal's 'كمان' cue and the chat 'kamaan filem' mark it; he said 'kamaan film'.
